raw: {"analysis":"Response HKK provides a more comprehensive plan that addresses all key constraints: the feature flag for Globex Corp, written approval from both Security Lead and VP of Product, cookie format immutability, CI cost management, and mock IdP flakiness. Response TSX has notable gaps: it only requires Security Lead sign-off for backward compatibility (missing VP of Product approval for production deployment), and its approach of deploying to production with the flag off before pilot verification contradicts the requirement to verify stability in staging with Globex Corp first. HKK also better handles the mock IdP flakiness by explicitly distinguishing environment noise from real failures, whereas TSX unrealistically assumes Lane C can simply 'stabilize' the mock IdP.","verdict":"HKK"}
